21/10/19

Copy of THE CHINA PRESS 21:10:1919.

NEW AMERICAN FIRM

Articles of incorporation were filed yesterday with
the clerk of the United States Court for a new concern,
the China International Corporation, with headquarters
in Shanghai. The authorised capital stock is $ls.
150,000 and the principal stockholders are Messrs. W.
S. Fleming, George E. Sokolsky and Mr. T. P. Hsi.
These three are also the Directors. Their petition
calls for a general exporting and importing business.
page_data.zh:
2672
1919年10月21日

《字林西报》1919年10月21日副本。

新的美国商行

昨日已向美国法院书记员提交注册文件，成立一家名为“中国国际公司”（China International Corporation）的新机构，总部设在上海。核定股本为150,000美元，主要股东为W. S. 弗莱明先生、乔治·E·索科尔斯基先生和T. P. 徐先生。此三人亦担任董事。其申请书中称将经营一般的进出口贸易业务。

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
2672
Extract from China Press dated 14:10:'4

Local Schools start Newspaper Courses.

A class in journalism has been started in the
McTyieres's School. Thirty young Chinese ladies are
attending. The course deals with news writing, Chinese
current topics and methods of handling news. Most of
the materials used are in connection with the work
of the China Bureau of Public Information. Works of
permanent value like researches in Chinese life will
be published later in book form.
The instruction is being carried out under the
direction of Mr. George Sokolski, manager of the bureau.
It is understood that a similar class will be soon
started in Futan College under Mr. Sokolski.

刑事侦缉处
2672
摘自1940年10月14日《字林西报》

本地学校开设新闻课程。

中西女塾已开设新闻学课程。三十名年轻中国女性正在就读。课程内容涉及新闻写作、中国时事话题以及新闻处理方法。所用教材大多与中国公共信息局的工作有关。具有持久价值的作品，如关于中国生活的研究，日后将以书籍形式出版。
教学工作在该局局长乔治·索科尔斯基先生的指导下进行。据悉，索科尔斯基先生不久还将在复旦大学开设类似的课程。

11/10/19

Extract from China Press dated 11:10:19.

Mr. George E. Sokolsky, manager of the China Bureau
of Public Information, returned to Shanghai from Tsinanfu
yesterday where he purchased the Shantung Ji Pao.
The new paper will be run by an American company, in which
Mr Carl Crow and Mr. J. B. Powell are interested.

1919年10月11日

摘自1919年10月11日《字林西报》。

中国公共信息局局长乔治·E·索科尔斯基先生昨日从济南返回上海，他在那里收购了《山东日报》。这份新报纸将由一家美国公司经营，卡尔·克劳先生和J. B. 鲍威尔先生在其中拥有权益。

Shanghai Municipal Police. 2672
12. 5. 19
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
12th May, 1919.
REPORT ON Watch on American of Russian Origin named Sokolosky,
who is suspected of Bolshevism.
Made by D.S.I. Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer.
Sir,
I beg to report that Sokolosky, the Bolshevist suspect,
has been watched since 2nd instant. An account of his
movements from that date to 10th instant are attached.
As Sokolosky's movements do not seem suspicious, I beg
to apply for instructions as to whether the watch may now be
withdrawn.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J.H. Givens
Detective Sub-Inspector.
Chief Detective Officer.
26/5/19.
Sokolosky is now working for the Shanghai
Gazette.
J.H.
See File No. 2749.

1919年5月12日。
中央巡捕房。
1919年5月12日。
关于监视一名涉嫌布尔什维主义的俄裔美国人索科洛斯基的报告。
由副督察吉文斯（Givens）撰写。经首席探员转呈。
阁下，
谨此报告，自本月2日起，一直对布尔什维克嫌疑犯索科洛斯基进行监视。随函附上其从该日至本月10日的行动记录。
鉴于索科洛斯基的行动似乎并无可疑之处，卑职恳请指示是否可以撤销监视。
阁下之恭顺仆人，
J.H. 吉文斯
副督察。
首席探员。
1919年5月26日。
索科洛斯基目前受雇于《上海泰晤士报》。
J.H.
参见档案号 2749。

30/4/19
Shanghai Municipal Police.
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
30th April, 1919.
REPORT ON Sokolsky, Self Confessed Bolshevist Showing American War Picture.
Made by D. S. I. Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer.
Sir,
In accordance with the D. S. P.'s instructions I interviewed Mr. A. J. Hughes of the China United Insurance Co., and he gave me the following information.
A pro ally Dane, who arrived here from Hankow en route for home on 24th April by the s.s. Kutwo, had an American of Russian or Polish extraction named Sokolsky for a travelling companion on the trip down the Yangtse. They had several conversations on board in the course of which Sokolsky admitted that he was a Bolshevist, and was ambitious to disseminate Bolshevist idea in China. He also boasted that he had been recently in close touch with Lenin and Trotsky, and that he had attended the socialist conference at Stockholm. He also claimed to have been present recently at secret meetings in Paris, Petrograd, the Murman Coast and Riga.
Enquiries go to show that Sokolsky is travelling all over China accompanied by an interpreter showing a picture entitled Gerard's Four Years in Germany in the various treaty ports. This picture will be shown at the Olympic Theatre, Bubbling Well Road within the next few days. Sokolsky resides at a boarding house, No. 38 Carter Road, which is kept by Mrs. Phillips, a British subject of Russian origin.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.I. Givens
Detective Sub-Inspector.
（批：C.D.O. Continue your watch on his movements. 30/4/19. C.D.O.）

1919年4月30日
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
中央巡捕房。
1919年4月30日。
关于自称布尔什维克分子并放映美国战争影片的索科尔斯基的报告。
由副督察吉文斯撰写。经首席探员转呈。
阁下，
遵照副总巡捕的指示，我约谈了中国联合保险公司的A. J. 休斯先生，他向我提供了以下信息。
一名亲协约国的丹麦人，于4月24日乘“古图”号轮船从汉口启程回国，途中在长江航段与一名俄裔或波兰裔美国人索科尔斯基结伴同行。他们在船上进行了多次交谈，期间索科尔斯基承认自己是布尔什维克分子，并野心勃勃地想在中国传播布尔什维克思想。他还吹嘘自己最近与列宁和托洛茨基保持密切联系，并出席了斯德哥尔摩的社会主义会议。他还声称最近出席了在巴黎、彼得格勒、摩尔曼海岸和里加举行的秘密会议。
调查显示，索科尔斯基正由一名翻译陪同，在中国各地巡回放映一部名为《杰拉德的德国四年》的影片，并在各通商口岸放映。该片将于近日在静安寺路奥林匹亚大戏院放映。索科尔斯基居住在卡德路38号的一家寄宿公寓，房东为菲利普斯太太，系俄裔英国臣民。
阁下之恭顺仆人，
D.S.I. 吉文斯
副督察。
（批注：首席探员。继续监视其行动。1919年4月30日。首席探员。）
